mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 35 degrees with overcast skies throughout the Badger Prairie County Park area under a full moon.

City news today covers the upcoming 2027 Spring Election. Candidate packets are ready for pickup at 111 Lincoln Street, and all paperwork must be filed by January 5th at 5:00 p.m. Also, remember that property tax bills will be in the mail by December 15th, with payment options available online or at the City Center drop box.

There is plenty to do in town today, including yoga at Insight Wellness and Thursday night events at ART House 360. Tomorrow, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or celebrate 50 years of brewing at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly police report, on November 2, officers were dispatched to West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
The Culver's of Verona is currently closed for the morning, but they will open today at 10:00 AM so you can enjoy today's delicious flavor of the day.
